mentions.name: docking.cc
mentions.description: A Linux dock bar that runs on Wayland and X11, with support for FreeBSD, OpenBSD, and NetBSD, and Windows support being experimented with. It ships with 60+ native applets such as WhatsApp, Hacker News, Reddit, Calendar, and Weather.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://docking.cc is a Linux dock bar with Wayland, X11, Linux, Free/Open/NetBSD and experimenting on Windows

It has 60+ native applets like WhatsApp, Hacker News, Reddit, Calendar, Weather, ...
mentions.author: edumucelli

mentions.name: docking
mentions.description: A dock bar application for Linux with support for both X11 and Wayland, pre-built packages for all major distributions, and almost 60 built-in applets.
mentions.audience: Linux users who use a dock bar
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been working on dock bar for Linux

* https://docking.cc

* https://github.com/edumucelli/docking

It has X11 and Wayland support, pre-built packages for all major distributions, almost 60 baked in applets.
mentions.author: edumucelli
